backup.title: Back Up Data
backup.intro: Creates one file with all your transactions, categories, budgets and preferences.
backup.privacyNote: The file is not encrypted. It is saved only where you choose — the app never uploads it. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup.shareHint: Send to Files, Google Drive, email or another app
backup.saveToFolderHint: Choose a folder on this device
backup.failed: Could not create the backup. Please try again.
backup.unavailable: Sharing is not available on this device

restore.title: Restore Data
restore.intro: Replace all data in the app with the contents of a backup file created by this app.
restore.preferencesNote: Preferences saved in the backup (language, voice language, theme) will also be restored.
restore.warningTitle: Your current data will be replaced
restore.warningMessage: Current data on this device — transactions: {{transactions}}, budgets: {{budgets}} — will be deleted and replaced. This cannot be undone.
restore.confirmMessage: All current data will be replaced by this backup. This cannot be undone.
restore.failed: Restore failed. Your existing data was not changed.

errors.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a backup.
errors.invalidJson: This file is damaged or is not a backup file.
errors.notBackup: This is not an Expense Tracker backup file.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.
errors.invalidStructure: This backup is incomplete or damaged.
errors.inconsistent: This backup contains inconsistent data and cannot be restored.

export.title: Export Transactions
export.intro: Choose a period. Transactions are exported as a CSV file (UTF-8) that spreadsheet apps can open.

clear.title: Clear all data?
clear.message:
This deletes all transactions and budgets from this device. Default categories and your preferences (language, theme) are kept.

Back up first if you may need this data later.
clear.confirmMessage: All transactions and budgets will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
clear.failed: Could not clear data. Nothing was deleted.
